model: RandomForest_Top10Features (scikit-learn Pipeline), selected by LOSO comparison across 5 candidate model families
evaluation_strategy: Leave-One-Subject-Out cross-validation across all 32 subjects, run independently for 5 candidate model families -- every subject held out exactly once per candidate, trained on the rest, all predictions pooled before computing metrics. Zero subject leakage between train and test at any point. The best candidate by pooled ROC-AUC (recall as tiebreaker) was then refit on ALL available data as the deployed model. These LOSO metrics are the honest generalization estimate for that model, not its training-set performance.
threshold_rationale: The dataset contains only 8 healthy subjects total, each held out exactly once under LOSO. With that few subjects, the sampling noise on a pooled generalization estimate is real -- the gate reflects what is honestly achievable on this public dataset rather than an arbitrary round number.
disclaimer: Trained on a public research dataset for demonstration purposes only. Never trained or evaluated on real patient data. Not used anywhere in the live patient workflow/orchestrator pipeline.
